_comment: Template for staged-clip ground truth (implementation guide §10).
Copy to ground_truth.json and fill in as you film. Note times while filming —
reconstructing them afterwards from video is slow and error-prone.
Aim for 20-30 clips. Clips with an EMPTY violations list are negative clips,
and they are the most valuable ones you can film: precision is unmeasurable
without them. The reversing head-turn clip is the make-or-break case.

violations.note: walks from 10 m to 3 m of a slowly moving forklift; should fire below 8.1 m

clips.note: NEGATIVE: person stays beyond 10 m throughout

NEGATIVE and the most important clip in the set: driver turns head to look behind while reversing. This is CORRECT behaviour. Any Rule 5 event here is a false positive that would destroy trust in the system. See context.md §6.3 and §9 Q3.
NEGATIVE: full traverse inside the walkway
NEGATIVE: Rule 1's false-positive twin. Also try adjusting a hard hat and holding a two-way radio.
NEGATIVE: normal operation, nothing should fire at all
